## Checklist

- [ ] Every changed fact has a source in `sources` (primary sources preferred)
- [ ] `as_of` is set to the date I checked the sources
- [ ] Summaries are in my own words, with no text copied from a source
- [ ] `npm run data` passes (CI runs it too)
- [ ] I work for a vendor whose record this changes: yes / no
